```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  rcases h with ⟨c, d⟩
  have h1 : c * d = 12 := h
  have h2 : c > d := ha
  have h3 : d > 2 := hb
  have h4 : d = 3 := by
    have h5 : d ≥ 3 := le_of_lt h3
    have h6 : d ≤ 3 := by
      intro h7
      rw [h7] at h1
      rw [mul_eq_of_left_eq_one (by simp) (by simp)] at h1
      exact lt_irrefl 12 h1
    exact eq_of_le_and_ge h5 h6
  have h7 : c * 3 = 12 := by rw [h1] at h7
  have h8 : c = 4 := by
    rw [h7]
    rw [mul_eq_of_left_eq_one (by simp) (by simp)]
  exact h8
```
